published_implementation.historical_relation: The benchmark executes named harnesses through Harbor or benchmark adapters while preserving each harness's normal prompt, context handling, temperature, tool strategy, and termination behavior. W1 does not adjudicate canonical historical linkage or infer exact upstream source revisions from display labels alone.
